maya.marketing: Quick sync 1 launch prep: need 1-slide benchmark, 2 battlecard variants, and 3 webinar Q&A soundbites. Keep vendor language generic.
priya.sales: SDRs want two cards: 'Econ-first' and 'Reliability-first'. 4 bullets each, plus 2 rapid rebuttals.
sam.benchmarks: Proposed slide stat: "Sample webchat (QPS60): median token latency 44ms, p95 335ms on Dedicated; ~30% lower per-token cost vs default managed endpoints." Will attach methods note.
eli.growth: For routing, A/B test Econ-first on trial signups, Reliability-first on security-tagged leads.
zoe.sdr: SDR play: short trigger map + 3-step follow: qualify -> AE if >10k tokens/mo -> nurture otherwise.
priya.sales: Draft Econ bullets: 1) Smart batching + adaptive quantization cuts unit cost. 2) Prescriptive config suggestions for workloads. 3) Predictable billing with reserved pools. 4) Easy SDK integration.
priya.sales: Draft Reliability bullets: 1) SLA-backed Dedicated pools. 2) Automatic model fallback and regional routing. 3) KV prefix caching reduces tail latency. 4) Private control plane option.
maya.marketing: Q&A soundbites: econ: "Unit economics come from batching + cache"; reliability: "Routing + fallbacks keep apps online"; rollout: "Canary + pinned models ease rollouts."
sam.benchmarks: Methods blurb: dataset=web_inbound_100; models=[open-7b, redwood-opt-7b]; infra=2xA100; steady-state run. PNG to follow.
maya.marketing: Owners: slides@saman, SDR cards@priya, routing@eli, playbook@zoe. First pass by Wednesday EOD.
priya.sales: Got it, will draft and share.
maya.marketing: Keep tone neutral and non-attacking. Thanks team. :rocket:
